verdict.rationale: ReadMe's own Ask AI feature is documented as giving readers instant answers from published documentation inside the hub, which covers the embedded reader-facing assistant. However, nothing in the evidence shows that answers include citations or links back into the content, and the support rests on a single short doc mention. Missing for 10: documented citations/source links in answers, depth of Ask AI documentation (configuration, answer behavior), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an embedded AI assistant on my docs site answers reader questions with citations into my content

citations.quote: Ask AI gives your users instant answers from your published documentation, directly inside your hub.
